sources.label: morphe patches for twitter and instagram
sources.author: Piko
patch_list: Add ability to copy media link
Blocks redirecting to the new X Android UI on launch
Blocks the 'This app is out of date' update screen from being shown on launch
Bring back old twitter logo and name
Changes the version code of the app. This will turn off app store updates and allows downgrading an existing app install to an older app version.
Removes tracking parameters when sharing links
Control video auto scroll in immersive view
Change the download directory for video downloads
Overrides existing share menu and adds a new one
Allows for using domains like fxtwitter when sharing tweets/posts.
Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
Unlocks the ability to download videos and gifs from Twitter/X
Replaces the default Twitter Blue with the user's Material You palette.
Videos will be played in highest quality always
Enables PiP mode when you close the app
Enables ability to undo posts before posting
Get translate option for all posts
Adds support for opening custom twitter links such as vxtwitter, fxtwitter, and fixupx within the app. These will have to be manually enabled under the "Open by default" section in the app info!
Hide badges from navigation bar icons
Hides notification nudges & counts from navigation bar icons
Adds an option to hide Floating action button
Hides followed by context under profile
Removes swipe up for more videos in video player
Hides follow/subscribe/follow back buttons on posts
Hides promote button under self posts
Adds options to hide recommendation items such as "Who to follow" and "Today's news" in timeline, search, and replies.
Hide recommended users that pops up when you follow someone
Adds an feature to export and import the token of accounts. This is useful when logging in on your second device or when re-installing piko.
Brings back username on post share links. Works post 11.4x.xx
Log json responses received from server
Adds more details on the profile page
Get rid of t.co short urls.
Search suggestions will not be saved locally
Removed promoted posts, trends and google ads
Hide/Remove search suggestion in explore section
Removes the view count from the bottom of tweets
Restores the legacy follower and following list screen.
Enable or disable rounding off numbers
Share tweets as rendered image. Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.
Shows changelogs when new a patch is installed.
Adds an option to show poll results without voting
Source label will be shown only on public posts

sources.label: New X on Android compatible piko builds
sources.author: Piko
patch_list: Adds a debug option to browse the tweet object in NewX post menus.
Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched X alongside the original X or other patched X.
Saves crash logs and shows a notification with share and copy actions.
Allows for using domains like fxtwitter when sharing tweets/posts.
Lets you hide selected items from the NewX navigation drawer, and optionally add Messages and Grok shortcuts.
Lets you hide selected actions from NewX post action bars.
Lets you hide selected items from the NewX photo and video long-press menu.
Reorder, hide, and replace NewX bottom navigation bar items.
Lets you hide selected items from the NewX post menu.
Reorder and hide the tabs shown on profile screens.
Lets you hide the For You or Following tab from the NewX home timeline.
Prevents automatic timeline jumps on startup and foregrounding.
Disables Haze blur in NewX Compose UI while preserving configured fallback tint and scrim effects.
Disables vertical swipes in the NewX video player while keeping playback controls and other gestures available.
Adds searchable, typed NewX feature switch overrides.
NewX: Filter For You by topic
Restricts the NewX For You timeline to selected topics.
Filters NewX posts using user-defined words and phrases.
Replaces the profile Photos timeline with a three-column media gallery.
Hides selected AI-generated posts from NewX timelines.
Removes the compose button from NewX timelines.
Removes the Discover more module from post-detail timelines.
Hides the new posts pill in NewX timelines.
Hides the Follow and Message buttons for post authors on post details.
Removes post and reply dividers shown in NewX timelines.
Hides the persistent post-detail reply bar while keeping the compose button available.
NewX: Hide posts by verified account type
Hides posts and replies authored by selected timeline-reported verification types.
Hides the premium upsell chip from the NewX home top bar.
Hides the Spaces bar above NewX timelines.
Removes the For You and Following tabs bar from NewX home timelines, with an option to hide the add-tab (+) button.
Hides recommended-user sections ("Who to follow") from NewX timelines and profile pages.
Adds a Download button below NewX posts and saves media to a folder you choose, with a customizable filename template.
Diagnostic only. Logs HLS playlist URIs and how rendition ids match the audio pattern. Needs piko logging enabled.
Opens the expanded (canonical) URL directly when clicking links instead of the shortened t.co link.
NewX: Redirect downloads to chosen folder
Saves media downloaded with NewX's own download buttons into the folders chosen for the download feature, using the configured filename template.
Filters promoted posts and modules from NewX timelines.
Reopens the pinned list, topic or community tab you last viewed when the app starts.
Persists supported timeline positions, then restores them after the app process restarts.
Bring back old Twitter icons and name
Captures parsed NewX server errors in memory and exports them on demand.
Lets you choose the default sub-tab (Photos or Videos) for the NewX profile media tab.
NewX: Set default profile post sorting
Lets you choose whether profile posts open sorted by the most recent or popular posts.
Lets you choose the default reply sorting order for NewX post detail.
Adds an option to show NewX poll results without voting.
Shows sensitive media without requiring confirmation in NewX.
Chooses between the original NewX colors and the Material You, high-contrast, and Dim themes.
Unlocks the built-in app color selector for non-Premium users.
Unlocks media downloads and offline video saving in NewX.

sources.label: This project shims legacy APIs by adding a lightweight compatibility layer, such
sources.author: X Shim
patch_list: Adds an abstracted shim layer for fields, which improves compatibility to allow legacy patches to work.
Adds an abstracted shim layer for methods, which improves compatibility to allow legacy patches to work.
Abstract shim layer for native library
Adds an abstracted shim layer for native libraries, which improves compatibility to allow legacy patches to work.

sources.label: Standalone, app-specific patches for use with Morphe
sources.author: kveld9 Extra
patch_list: Disables background periodic jobs, home screen widgets, and companion services to reduce resource usage.
Blocks tracking services, analytics collection, and advertising identifiers, redirects Braze and Sentry endpoints to 0.0.0.0, and purges Sentry manifest metadata.

STUB placeholder. Real behavior authored after disassemble.yml runs on com.twitter.android.

sources.label: Kareem
sources.author: Kareem
patch_list: Rewrites generated Twitter/X share links to nitter.kareem.one.
Bypasses X/Twitter PairIP integrity startup checks that crash after APKM repacking.
Stops Twitter/X from appending tracking query parameters to shared links.

sources.label: Personal Android app patches for use with Morphe
sources.author: Ahmed Yarub
patch_list: Add ability to copy media link
Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.
Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.
Hides options from the post menu.
Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.
Sets the sort replies open with.
Hides tabs from the Explore page.
Hides actions from the bar under each post.
Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.
Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.
Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.
Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.
Hides rows from the side bar.
Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.
Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.
Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.
Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.
Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.
Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.
Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.
Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.
Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.
Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.
Hide badges from navigation bar icons
Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.
Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.
Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.
Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.
Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.
Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.
Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.
Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.
Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.
Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.
Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.
Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.
Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.
Shows media marked sensitive without blurring it behind a warning.
Adds "Open in downloader" to the post menu, which shares the post's link with an app of your choice.
Makes the app's own Premium subscription checks always pass. Features the server enforces still need a subscription.
